articles.title: Israel on the Brink: Eisenkot's Three Paths to Power, Netanyahu's Iran Warning and the Arab Vote
articles.description: Gadi Eisenkot is prepared to form a national emergency government even without a conventional parliamentary majority, setting up a confrontation with Benjamin Netanyahu. Negotiations with ultra-Orthodox parties, a possible deal with Likud and the prospect of Arab-backed minority rule have placed Israel at a political crossroads. With Iran looming over the debate, the former military chief is accusing Netanyahu of exploiting security fears and deepening divisions within Israeli society. Israel on the Brink: Eisenkot's Three Paths to Power, Netanyahu's Iran Warning and the Arab Vote

articles.title: Netanyahu Calls Iran Strike 'Unavoidable' as Trump Rallies Xi and Putin on Nuclear Proliferation
articles.description: Netanyahu reportedly calls a military operation against Iran 'unavoidable' as Israel awaits Trump's decision amid nuclear proliferation talks with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin.
